items.title: Manchester Airports Group Data on 8.8 Million People Leaked After Ransom Refusal
items.description: Hacker group published roughly 550GB of data after MAG reportedly refused to pay a ransom demand; the group says it gained access via exposed admin keys. The post Manchester Airports Group Data on 8.8 Million People Leaked After Ransom Refusal appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.description: Microsoft says a known issue that reverts mouse settings after installing the KB5120998 August 2026 preview update affects only non-English Windows 11 systems. [...]

items.title: Critical Elementor Pro flaw exploited to take over WordPress sites
items.description: A recently patched critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-32475) in the Elementor Pro plugin for WordPress is being exploited in attacks that deliver a webshell payload and execute arbitrary commands on the server. [...]

items.title: Your Employee’s Password Appeared in an Infostealer Log. Now What?
items.description: Infostealers can expose far more than passwords, including authenticated sessions that may let attackers bypass MFA. Flare explains how defenders can prioritize compromised identities, determine whether stolen access is still usable, and respond before it leads to account takeover. [...]

items.title: HiddenLayer Raises $100 Million for AI Runtime Security

items.title: 153 Million Driver License Images Offered on Dark Web
items.description: Cybercriminals are offering digital scans of US and Canadian driver’s licenses, likely stolen from IDScan.net. The post 153 Million Driver License Images Offered on Dark Web appeared first on SecurityWeek.
